flags.message: Case identity conflict blocks substantive evaluation of gemini-baseline, claude-baseline, and codex-baseline. event.yaml names Mara Nathan v. Alamo Heights ISD; all three August 20, 2026 forecasts analyze the Texas Ten Commandments/Fifth Circuit dispute. The provisioned record/snapshots/2026-10-13.json instead identifies Theodore James Purdy v. Kansas, No. 26-221, from the Kansas Court of Appeals and records an October 13 denial. Current petition.txt and questions-presented.txt concern Purdy's Confrontation Clause claim; documents.json records an October 5 fetch and 140 pages, whereas candidates describe a 314-page Nathan petition. Original prediction-time snapshots are not staged, so the cause cannot be assigned and Nathan's actual outcome is unknown here. Required correct/Brier fields mechanically compare to the supplied denial (0/0.81 for gemini-baseline, 0/0.5184 for claude-baseline and codex-baseline); these are not reliable matched-case performance. reasoning_quality is null for each, with details in evaluation.md. Reconcile case/event/document/outcome association and reevaluate before treating these cells as scored performance. This is not evidence of leakage, and leakage_suspected was not used as a substitute data-quality exclusion.
